clue.text: Pause during race to turn top on damaged post

indicators.note: damaged letters are knocked out of shape into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone rights a fallen post during a pause in a race, flipping its top back on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top' looks like a verb or the post's upper end; it is a noun synonym. 'on' just places one piece before the other in this across entry.
explanation.definitionFit: In motor racing a driver halts briefly in the pits for fuel and tyres, a short break mid-race.

clue.text: Instagram contribution covering points for spiced drink

clue.text: Colour in comic book character

parts.note: a tint is a shade of colour

explanation.definitionFit: Hergé's young Belgian reporter with a quiff is the hero of a famous comic-strip series.

clue.text: Fox eating a waste product in fungi

parts.note: tod is a dialect word for a fox
stools are faeces, bodily waste

explanation.definitionFit: These are umbrella-shaped mushrooms, often poisonous, which are kinds of fungus.

explanation.surface: A valuable about to be brought back to a strongbox.
explanation.definitionFit: In criminal slang a safe-breaker cracks a peter, an old word for a strongbox.

taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'court' looks like a law court; it is the verb meaning woo.

clue.text: Silly fashion upset head of textiles

clue.text: Republican rabble leaders put mobile into roadside bomb that's exploded

clue.text: Sit alone twiddling lower extremities

explanation.definitionFit: Father Christmas is the legendary deliverer of presents, wrapped parcels brought down chimneys.

clue.text: Time to request stuff for working party

to stuff something in is to force or cram it in

to fail to spot something is to miss it
Aries is a sign of the zodiac

clue.text: Plant found mostly in decaying vegetable matter

parts.note: peat is partly decayed plant material from bogs

clue.text: Top people act differently to this prominent Mexican feature

indicators.note: acting differently means the letters behave in another order

clue.text: University lecturer interrupting enthusiastic reception for part of cycle

parts.note: an ovation is enthusiastic applause

clue.text: Animal full of vegetables died satisfied

indicators.note: full of means containing, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: an ape is an animal
peas are vegetables

explanation.surface: A creature stuffed with greens died contented.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone placated or pacified has had their demands met, so they are satisfied.

clue.text: Arms trade leaders entertained by numerous delegates

indicators.note: entertained by means held within, so the first piece goes inside

parts.note: legion means very many, numerous

indicators.note: leaders are the front letters of each word

explanation.surface: Arms-trade bosses are wined and dined by many conference delegates.
explanation.definitionFit: A diplomatic mission headed by a minister, and its staff, is a body of envoys or delegates.

clue.text: Priest leaving church leader a true tale translated for Alfred, Lord Tennyson once

parts.note: the Pope leads the Roman Catholic church

clue.text: Popular company's not in good shape

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable
a firm is a company

explanation.definitionFit: Being weak or frail through age or illness means one's health is poor.

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy, sailors

explanation.definitionFit: On a ship, toward or at the stern means at the back or behind.

clue.text: Essentially miserable time?

indicators.note: essentially points to the essence or core, the central letters of the word

explanation.definitionFit: An age or epoch is a period of history, a span of time.

clue.text: Bones intended, it's said, for special religious ceremonies

explanation.definitionFit: Baptism and the Eucharist are examples of the Christian rites through which grace is conferred.

clue.text: Inflexible soldier breaking free

parts.note: to rid is to free
GI is an American soldier

parts.note: a plague is an epidemic

clue.text: Great and good tucked into alcoholic beverage found in grass

indicators.note: tucked into means placed inside

parts.note: wine is an alcoholic drink

clue.text: Mafia boss hiding gun parts and drug in prison

parts.note: E is short for ecstasy, a drug
